source.scope: Host Lua GUI double; not native pointer, mouse-wheel, focus, scroll offset or rendering proof

observed_source_mechanism.severity: Independent source-design parity gap requiring real GUI qualification; no native failure observed by this fixture
observed_source_mechanism.mir5: The Availability builder clears the Research content unconditionally and constructs a new named inner scroll-pane. It does not record its vertical offset or a visible-row anchor, and has no restoration call.
observed_source_mechanism.navigation: The selected-tab-changed event updates view.tab and rerenders. Returning to Research with visibility=3 enters the clearing Availability builder even when the query and authored rows are unchanged.
observed_source_mechanism.adjacent_research: Normal Research has explicit view.scroll/list.scroll_to_item recovery; it does not apply to the Availability inner scroll-pane.
observed_source_mechanism.mir4: Published MIR4 v4.7.3 represents omissions as a list-box selected_index from v.omission_selection and updates that index on selection. This is a different interaction model: it establishes remembered selection, not a guarantee of identical scroll pixels or MIR5 Availability semantics.
observed_source_mechanism.tab_geometry: The tabbed pane is constructed above the Research content. Rebuilding Availability does not itself show a displaced tab strip. Stable geometry still requires native pixels at changed viewport/locale.

input_and_oracle_constraints.source_fixture: Reuse existing authored 24-entry/three-width Availability host projection only for simulated overflow structure; do not infer native click/scroll pass from that host fixture.
input_and_oracle_constraints.native: For real scroll/input qualification use an existing owner-reviewed graphical controller and exact approved engine/mod closure, or prepare a distinct bounded non-dispatched input. Record original query, viewport dimensions, first/last visible row or native scroll offset before/after, tab geometry, locale, accepted screenshots and independent readback.
input_and_oracle_constraints.alternative_profile: Do not assume the currently supplied Base-only or Bob/Angel mods produce enough Availability rows to overflow; confirm actual row count or use an explicitly documented test fixture.
input_and_oracle_constraints.expected_vs_observed: Proposed retention behavior requires the product/MIR4 parity owner to approve it. An unexecuted code trace is not a demonstrated gameplay/UI regression or a stable gate pass.
